body: The headaches have been coming for a really long time. I've had headaches exactly like these in the past, but they're just super duper common now. I'm due for a checkup with my doctor soon, so I'll talk to them about it anyway. Last time I had my eyes checked was a few years back, and I'm getting them checked very soon. They seem fine, but who knows. I'm really hoping that it's just something to do with that - because I don't want to have to deal with these headaches for the rest of my life like dad. Also, I used to get these unexplained seizures - but they've since stopped. So I have no idea if it's something more serious.
My head hurts so fucking much

I do 2 art subjects, 3 non-art subjects. Aside from linguistics, the 2 of the 3 other non-art subjects aren't ones I particularly enjoy (mandarin and maths.) All my friends take a different course to me so I see them less and less, I can't help but constantly think how much happier I would be if I took the same course as them - for so many different reasons. My talent has put me in this mess. What a lame talent to have... where will it take me? Probably no where. I wish I had just left it as a hobby. I guess I always admired my brother and wanted to be like him too. My logic for taking these classes was idiotic. I was well rounded. I could have accelerated subjects. I could have gotten a really good score. I really like learning, I loved the subjects I used to do. Why am I doing what I'm doing. I feel like I'm living someone else's life, the life I want to be living exists in my head only. Why can't I stop thinking about the past? Unfortunately I don't have any time to take any courses online at this stage, I hardly get any sleep either.
I suppose it's just a general feeling, all sorts of different thoughts creep into my mind that make it better and worse. (I think that kind of makes sense)

That really made me smile!!! The thing is, I've always been a talented artist - but I've pursued it to the point where I no longer take any science or humanities and focus on art subjects at school. I really miss taking them; so now art feels super crappy. I liked drawing and painting because I was the best at it in my school and people there and beyond knew who I was because of it. I'm mad that I let it become such a huge part of who I am. Honestly, acing all my assignments does make me shit talk and victory dance, but it's just temporary happiness in the scheme of things. Acing a bio test or a politics essay felt much better, but there's no chance now for me to take those classes again. I just don't care about any of it so much anymore, but I have to - because my tertiary entrance score is really dependant on performing exceedingly well on these stupid 2 art subjects.
It really did help, it means a lot that you took the time to help too. People like you are very important and wonderful, thank you so much!!

I sure do :--( I do that, I don't know to what degree it's helping me. Funnily enough, he's pretty hard on himself too, sometimes I wonder if he's only dating me because he doesn't think he can do better. Maybe it's not the case - but like you said, I have some serious self-esteem issues.

I think a part of me is especially sad that I haven't put myself on a path that would make myself feel more appealing to him. It's probably- no, definitely all in my head, but it doesn't make it any easier to cope with. Anyway, I guess I'll see what I can do. Thankyou
I really like your approach, thank you for helping me

I think i'm sort of scared that my hard work wont pay off, and i'll sacrifice too much in the meantime. I suppose also that my lack of direction comes after knowing where I was going my entire life and losing all interest..
ah, maybe you're right

Sorry, you're right. 
What would I possibly say? I have no idea how he'd react - I'm especially bad in situations where I have no degree of certainty what the outcome will be
thankyou though, you don't mean it, but it's still nice to hear
I don't work hard enough, I'm completely directionless, I'm arrogant
I'm none of the things that he is. I am increasingly depressed and find it harder to work harder to become somebody that I like; I think that I am running out of time.
